concurrent.sample_output: An attacker exploits an unauthenticated deserialization endpoint by sending malicious serialized data to the server, which the server then deserializes without proper validation or authentication. This can lead to arbitrary code execution if the deserialized object contains harmful instructions. To detect this vulnerability, defenders should monitor network traffic for unusual serialized payloads and implement input validation checks on deserialization processes. Additionally, employing security tools like static application security testing (SAST) and dynamic application security testing (DAST) can help identify deserialization flaws. Regular security audits and staying updated with the latest security patches are also crucial preventive measures.
